title: Home guide: the cup and cling film model of the water cycle
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: States of matter (Marvellous Medicine and How Far Can Sound Travel?)
source: Written for science/y4 lesson 12 (Home practical guide and safety card: cup and cling film model (portal worksheet; warm tap water only, adult pours))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

safety: Warm tap water only; an adult pours it
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: An adult pours a little warm tap water into the cup.
Cover the cup tightly with cling film.
Put an ice cube on top of the cling film.
Look under the cling film: what has formed?
